(1) Rate schedules showing base distribution rates for effect on and after January 1, 2026; (2) A new tariff for effect as of January 1, 2026, authorizing a $30 Bill Stabilization Credit for Rate Class R-3 and R-4 customers in the months of January 2026 and February 2026, and of $25 in March 2026. (3) A revised Revenue Decoupling Adjustment Clause tariff, reflecting the incremental recovery of the Bill Stabilization Credits from residential heating customers and revised revenue decoupling targets that reflect the proposed base distribution rates. 4) A revised Local Distribution Adjustment Clause tariff, reflecting reconciliation of Service Quality Penalties to ensure that any penalty is precisely returned to customers, and updated Exhibit ES-RDC-1 (previously filed in D.P.U. 25-53).
